name: Seeds: Geometric Properties of Wheat Kernels
description: The Seeds dataset is a classical agricultural pattern recognition benchmark from the UCI Machine Learning Repository providing internal geometric measurements of wheat grains (caryopses). Collected by researchers at the Institute of Agrophysics of the Polish Academy of Sciences in Lublin, the dataset comprises 210 instances evenly distributed across three distinct wheat cultivars: Kama, Rosa, and Canadian (70 instances each). Samples were measured using a non-destructive soft X-ray imaging technique and analyzed via the GRAINS image processing system to extract seven continuous morphological attributes: Area, Perimeter, Compactness, Length of kernel, Width of kernel, Asymmetry coefficient, and Length of kernel groove.
